title: Special: How Devil Fruits come back
facts: Rebirth into a nearby fruit, Vegapunk, Punk Hazard (Smiley, candy, Shinokuni, apple)
Ace's Mera Mera: Doflamingo, Corrida Colosseum, Sabo
Blackbeard took the Gura Gura, method unknown

plan.english: Special: How Devil Fruits come back after their user dies
plan.fruit: Uses existing fruit designs (Axolotl drawn new; Mera Mera, Gura Gura).

lines.text: What happens to a Devil#red Fruit when its user dies?#purple
lines.say: What happens to a Devil Fruit when its user dies?

lines.text: Don't panic,#red the power doesn't die#purple with them.
lines.say: Don't panic, the power doesn't die with them.

lines.text: Only one#gold of each Devil Fruit can exist#blue at a time.
lines.say: Only one of each Devil Fruit can exist at a time.

lines.text: So while its user is alive,#green nobody else can ever find#orange it.
lines.say: So while its user is alive, nobody else can ever find it.

lines.text: But the moment the user dies,#red the power leaves#purple their body.
lines.say: But the moment the user dies, the power leaves their body.

lines.text: It jumps into a normal fruit#green nearby, and that fruit becomes the same Devil Fruit again:#pink same swirls, same power.#gold
lines.say: It jumps into a normal fruit nearby, and that fruit becomes the same Devil Fruit again: same swirls, same power.

lines.text: Doctor Vegapunk#blue figured this out, and we saw it happen on Punk Hazard.#orange
lines.say: Doctor Vegapunk figured this out, and we saw it happen on Punk Hazard.

lines.text: Caesar Clown#purple fed the Axolotl Fruit to Smiley,#pink a giant blob of poison gas.#green
lines.say: Caesar Clown fed the Axolotl Fruit to Smiley, a giant blob of poison gas.

lines.text: When Smiley ate a piece of candy,#pink it burst into the deadly gas Shinokuni#purple and died.
lines.say: When Smiley ate a piece of candy, it burst into the deadly gas Shinokuni and died.

lines.text: And right next to it, an ordinary apple#red turned into the Axolotl Fruit.#pink
lines.say: And right next to it, an ordinary apple turned into the Axolotl Fruit.

lines.text: The same thing happened to Ace's Flame-Flame#orange Fruit.
lines.say: The same thing happened to Ace's Flame-Flame Fruit.

lines.text: Ace died at Marineford,#red and two years later his fruit ended up in Doflamingo's#pink hands.
lines.say: Ace died at Marineford, and two years later his fruit ended up in Doflamingo's hands.

lines.text: Doflamingo made it the grand prize#gold of the Corrida Colosseum#orange in Dressrosa.
lines.say: Doflamingo made it the grand prize of the Corrida Colosseum in Dressrosa.

lines.text: Luffy entered to win his brother's#red fruit, but Sabo#blue took his place, won, and ate#orange it.
lines.say: Luffy entered to win his brother's fruit, but Sabo took his place, won, and ate it.

lines.text: Now Sabo fights with Ace's flames.#orange
lines.say: Now Sabo fights with Ace's flames.

lines.text: But one man broke#red the rules.
lines.say: But one man broke the rules.

lines.text: When Whitebeard#blue died, Blackbeard#purple stole his Tremor-Tremor power, and nobody knows how#gold he did it.
lines.say: When Whitebeard died, Blackbeard stole his Tremor-Tremor power, and nobody knows how he did it.

lines.text: So if you ever find a weird swirly#purple fruit, someone, somewhere, just had a really bad#red day.
lines.say: So if you ever find a weird swirly fruit, someone, somewhere, just had a really bad day.

lines.text: Which fruit do#pink you want next? Follow#gold for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
